calm-breathing.name: Sabhalal le ufuyrubiyya
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Sabhalal le ufuyrubtih soolo idoola kee hanaawiseenit
calm-breathing.description: caatih, tibba le ufuyrubtih soolo tabaatabsaanam: sahlin maroyta dadaltaah lica ufuyrubtih shrink. Atu qimbissaah, faxe uddur soolissam duddah.
calm-breathing.short: ufuy rubtuh caatih tan maroyta. Atu faxxa wak qimbisaay soolis.
calm-breathing.intro: Inki inki way tayse abnisso tibba le soolo. "Qimmis" xag, tokkeek maroyta elle dadaltaamal ufuy rubtaah, iroh ufuy ruuba. Taciilah akkek sissik tulsika doorita. tah dayla hinna, dubuk salaam le uddur tabaatabsaanam.
howTo: raacat luk daffeya tattab tattab.
Silka door: caatih akkek caatih.
"Qimmis" xag. maroyta dadaltah tan uddur ufuy rub, kee irol ufuy rubta wak.
laca ufuyrubtik lakal isih soolissa, hinnay faxxa wak "solis" xag.
tips: gaba ibbix hinnay gaba numtin mogoyul daffes toh unkaq muquk temeetek.

inki num ufuy rubti taqabi le kaa tekkek, qaadik ufuy ruubaay uxxuuk maroyta wagita. Esser daylaabe wagittam faxe ufuyrubtih bohoy.

faq.a: bale. tah sahlinih, doorit soolo sabhalal kee kampaani. tah dayla hinna bohoy akkek faxe caalatal. Qaafiyat bohoyut daylaabe lih yab.
bale. tu tangayyem atu qimbis xagtam fan, kee toh soolele laca ufuyrubtik lakal hinnay atu soolis xagta wak. ku yahaaz angoyya salcisuh gulgulume kaa tekkek, qangor maroyta dadale kal milaagimtah.
